d.ko: Neighbors: Suburban Warfare is a chaotic online multiplayer party brawler where suburban rivals go to war. Team up with friends in wild PvE and PvP matches, destroy rival houses with everyday items turned weapons, and defend your home using traps, gadgets, and crazy team combos.
d.en: Neighbors: Suburban Warfare is a chaotic online multiplayer party brawler where suburban rivals go to war. Team up with friends in wild PvE and PvP matches, destroy rival houses with everyday items turned weapons, and defend your home using traps, gadgets, and crazy team combos.
d.zh: 在这个充满混乱的在线团队对抗游戏中，你将与讨厌的邻居展开战斗。 社区的居民们身怀绝技，集结队伍，使用奇葩的道具攻击对手的房屋，同时布置陷阱守卫自己的房屋。 谁的家能撑到最后，称霸整个街区？
